hooks.text: 战斗自动进行，真正胜负点在开战前根据敌方威胁调整矮人的阵型与站位。
hooks.excerpt: Battles play out automatically, so the real challenge happens before the fight begins. Choose the right formation and position for your Dwarves as you are preparing for specific enemy threats, often deciding the outcome long before the first blow is struck.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每名矮人都能通过装备塑造成前排坦克、近战输出或需要保护的强力法师。
hooks.excerpt: Every Dwarf can be shaped into a distinct party-member through gear and equipment. Build sturdy frontline tanks to hold the line, deadly damage dealers to tear through enemies with meele combat, or fragile but powerful mages that need protection.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每场战斗后都要在经验、装备投入和招募新成员之间选择，让队伍成长走向不同路线。
hooks.excerpt: After each battle, you choose how to proceed. Gain experience, invest gold into better equipment, or recruit new Dwarves to strengthen your group. Every choice pushes your run in a different direction, and not every path leads to survival.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
